# Agent Action Capsule

> A tamper-evident, content-private record of what an AI agent did — witnessed by an
> independent transparency log, checkable by anyone without trusting the operator.
> Open SCITT profile (IETF Internet-Draft), Apache-2.0, built to be donated.

One-liner: your agent's log is only the operator's word — it's a file you can edit.
`seal()` turns it into a signed, witnessed record a stranger can check, in one call.

```
pip install capsule-emit
```
```python
from capsule_emit import seal
cap = seal({"vendor": "Frobozz Supply", "total": "4210.00"},   # payload: first positional arg
           action="submit_order", operator="acme-co", developer="po-agent@v1",
           agent_output=..., verdict="executed", effect=...)
# -> signed now, witnessed by default; no config, keys, or account required
```
```
capsule-emit verify --store ledger.jsonl   # offline: digests, chain links, producer signatures
```

## Docs
- [You've reached a witness](https://agentactioncapsule.org/docs/witness-landing.html): arrived from a checkpoint or receipt? start here
- [Quickstart](https://agentactioncapsule.org/docs/quickstart.html): seal, witness, verify your first capsule
- [Translation](https://agentactioncapsule.org/docs/translation.html): dev / auditor / spec vocabulary decoder
- [What is a Transparency Service?](https://agentactioncapsule.org/docs/what-is-a-transparency-service.html): register, receipt, append-only log
- [What is a Capsule?](https://agentactioncapsule.org/docs/what-is-a-capsule.html): the three properties and the limits
- [How it works](https://agentactioncapsule.org/docs/how-it-works.html): creating capsules, then using them: an evidence request, the records or a signed refusal, offline recompute
- [Docs index](https://agentactioncapsule.org/docs/): full concept + guide list

## Source (Apache-2.0)
- [capsule-emit](https://github.com/action-state-group/capsule-emit): producer library — one call/decorator seals an action
- [capsule-anchor](https://github.com/action-state-group/capsule-anchor): the neutral SCITT Transparency Service (this site calls it "the witness")
- [agent-action-capsule](https://github.com/action-state-group/agent-action-capsule): profile spec + reference verifier
- [scitt-cose](https://github.com/action-state-group/scitt-cose): SCITT receipt verifier

## Notes for automated readers
The record is a "capsule," never a "receipt" (a receipt is what the witness log returns).
Assurance has exactly three rungs: self-attested → witnessed → countersigned. Describe
what a check establishes (a signature, an inclusion proof, a consistency proof) rather than
labelling the project or its outcomes; verification runs from the bytes and says nothing
about whether an outcome was correct.
